blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
We measure our products in kilos, bags and tonnes. One bag of sugar weighs 50 kilos. One tonne equals 1,000 kilos.

A big ship can carry 50,000 tonnes of sugar. That is a lot! We use a scale to check the weight. The weight goes on every label.

Today you learn 5 important words. We start slow. You can do it! English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts.

items.q: How much does one bag of sugar weigh?
items.why: "One bag of sugar weighs 50 kilos."

items.q: How many kilos are in one tonne?
items.why: "One tonne equals 1,000 kilos."

items.q: What do we use to check the weight?
items.why: "We use a scale to check the weight."

items.q: The text says the weight goes on every label. This suggests that…
items.why: Inferência: se o peso está em toda etiqueta, é uma informação importante.

items.q: A ship carries 50,000 tonnes. The text suggests a ship can carry…
items.why: Inferência: 50.000 toneladas é muito — "That is a lot!"

blocks.instruction: Ouça o colaborador no depósito. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning. I am at the warehouse today. I have a new shipment of sugar here, and I need to weigh it.

First, I put one bag on the scale. The scale shows the weight. One bag weighs 50 kilos. That is normal. Every bag is 50 kilos.

Now I count the bags. I have 20 bags. Twenty bags times 50 kilos is 1,000 kilos. So this is one tonne. One tonne equals 1,000 kilos.

I write the weight on the label. The weight goes on every label, so the client can check it. This is very important.

I check the scale every day. A good scale gives the right number. If the scale is wrong, the weight is wrong too. So I clean it and I test it in the morning.

Numbers with units are easy: 50 kilos, 20 bags, one tonne. We start slow, and we do it right. You can do it too!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where is the speaker today?
items.why: "I am at the warehouse today."

items.q: How many bags does the speaker have?
items.why: "I have 20 bags."

items.q: Why does the speaker check the scale every day?
options: Because a good scale gives the right number
items.why: "A good scale gives the right number. If the scale is wrong, the weight is wrong too."

items.q: Twenty bags of 50 kilos make one tonne. This suggests that…
items.why: Inferência: 20 × 50 = 1.000 kilos = uma tonelada.

items.q: The speaker writes the weight so the client can check it. This suggests the weight must be…
items.why: Inferência: se o cliente confere, o peso precisa estar certo e claro.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "One tonne equals 1,000 kilos." A tonne is…
items.why: Tonne = tonelada, uma unidade de peso igual a 1.000 quilos.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Please put the sugar on the ___ to see the weight."
items.why: Scale = balança, o que mostra o peso.

items.q: "I carry one bag of sugar." A bag here is…
items.why: Bag = saca, o recipiente com o açúcar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The label shows the ___ : 50 kilos."
items.why: Weight = peso; é o que a etiqueta mostra.

items.q: "A bag weighs 50 kilos." A kilo is…
items.why: Kilo = quilo, uma unidade de peso.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no depósito e no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you weigh this bag for me?" To weigh means to…
items.why: To weigh = pesar, medir o peso.

items.q: "Please check the scale every morning." To check means to…
options: look at it to see if it is right
items.why: To check = verificar, conferir se está certo.

items.q: "We need to write down the weight." To write down means to…
items.why: Write down = anotar, escrever no papel ou etiqueta.

items.q: "The ship can carry 50,000 tonnes." To carry means to…
items.why: To carry = carregar, transportar algo.

items.q: "You can do it! We start slow." "You can do it" means…
items.why: "You can do it" = você consegue, uma frase de incentivo.
